note: Conscious non-coverage for the emergency standards baseline. Every declared standard is DEFERRED here because no governed CKP content cites it YET — a vendored chart and even a tested engine are not the same as a rule in the clinical knowledge platform that names the standard, which is what 'implemented' means to this register. Each entry names the wave that will implement it (content citing the standardId via dakRef + adaptation) and the condition that brings it back. An entry that survives its planned wave is a signal, not paperwork; delete it when the content lands and the standard flips to SHIPPED.

exclusions.reason: The WhoIittEngine that encodes this chart exists and is tested (libs/emergency-domain), but it is a library on the shelf — not wired into pct and not cited by governed CKP triage content, so nothing yet makes it the acuity of record.
